callPath: AnyEditorDocumentStore.apply -> read -> Self.matches -> verifiedCurrent + optional Undo
dispatchConclusion: No canonical-equality no-op filter found in prepareTextEdit/prepare/apply or the HTTP request construction. The exact requested string remains in set.text and the original apply dispatches PATCH after its existing authorization fences.
sourceSerializationConclusion: UI AnyInlineMarkdown is a typealias to the Host implementation. Replacement operates on original NSString ranges, escapes only listed ASCII Unicode scalars, reconstructs original fragments with an exact UTF-8 guard, and requires exact projected display/semantic text. Marker identities are retained from original wrappers. No normalization/no-op suppression found in this inspected typing/marker route.

finding.comparison: Self.matches uses synthesized AnyJSON Equatable for each requested field, including text. Exact primary AnyJSON has a String associated value and no custom equality implementation. Swift canonical String equality therefore permits raw UTF-8-different equivalents.
finding.effect: A version-matching readback with a canonically equal but byte-different text value can satisfy this Host field check and return verifiedCurrent plus an Undo value. This is a source-demonstrable verification weakness; no claim is made that the native engine actually normalized a response in a retained run.
finding.illustrativeInput: requested e\u{0301}, returned \u{00e9}; likewise the new Hebrew combining-order case. No synthetic Swift/native execution was performed.
finding.UIBoundary: The reviewed82b5 UI flush independently performs another readback and saved.text.utf8.elementsEqual(draft.inlineMarkdown.utf8); it rejects the mismatch. This finding does not revoke that UI guard or claim silently accepted wrong text through fixed flush.

proposedNarrowChange: Only requested string field text uses exact UTF-8 in the existing Host matcher. Preserve non-text equality, unset semantics, lease/ACL/version/dispatch flow, receipt structure and Undo construction. Do not change global AnyJSON equality.
regressionRequirement: Use actual AnyEditorDocumentStore.apply, its real HTTP client and read path with a controlled loopback HTTP response. Check raw requested PATCH bytes, canonically equal mismatched readback -> unverified/no Undo, and exact readback -> verified/Undo. A helper-equality-only test is insufficient.
